description: Ministry of Mahaweli, Agriculture and Irrigation - Declare the Moragahakanda,  Kaluganga Mahaweli, 'F'  Zone as a sustainable Development Area
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Chamal Rajapakse, Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development) AND detailed descriptions of the functions, objectives, and responsibilities for the declared sustainable development area. The content includes specific agricultural, environmental, and economic development responsibilities that go beyond a simple appointment, making it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3) according to the classification rules.
